description: This file contains utility classes and functions for transforming messages and events between A2A and OpenAI formats, including message conversion, streaming event generation, and handling of response content.

classes.name: A2AStreamingContext
classes.description: Holds context information for A2A streaming sessions, including task ID, context ID, accumulated message, and emission flags.

classes.name: A2ACompletionBridgeTransformation
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting messages and events between A2A and OpenAI formats, as well as creating streaming event payloads.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] a2a_message_to_openai_messages( a2a_message: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Converts an A2A message dict into a list of OpenAI message dicts with role and content.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] openai_response_to_a2a_response( response: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms a LiteLLM ModelResponse into an A2A SendMessageResponse format.

methods.name: str _get_timestamp()
methods.description: Returns current timestamp in ISO format with timezone.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_task_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, )
methods.description: Creates an initial task creation event with 'submitted' status, to be emitted at the start of a streaming response.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_status_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a status update event reflecting the current processing state, such as 'working' or 'completed'.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_artifact_update_event( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, text: str, )
methods.description: Creates an artifact update event containing provided text content.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
methods.description: Converts a LiteLLM streaming chunk into a legacy A2A streaming format event (deprecated for streaming, recommended to use event creation methods).

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, request_id: str, input_message: Dict[str, Any]):$/

ctags.name: create_status_update_event
ctags.signature: ( ctx: A2AStreamingContext, state: str, final: bool = False, message_text: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: openai_chunk_to_a2a_chunk
ctags.signature: ( chunk: Any, request_id: Optional[str] = None, is_final: bool = False, )
